data.title: WLVU (FM)
data.description: Radio station in Belle Meade, Tennessee, United States
data.extract: WLVU is an FM radio station licensed to the city of Belle Meade, Tennessee, but serving the Nashville market as a whole. It is currently branded as K-LOVE, repeating a satellite-delivered contemporary Christian format. The station is owned by Educational Media Foundation and is one of the two flagship of the K-Love brands based in nearby Franklin, Tennessee. It is Nashville's most recent full-power FM station to take the air.
